pages.text: A morphogen made at one end and broken down everywhere spreads into a gradient c = c0.e^(-x/lambda), lambda = sqrt(D/k). Each cell reads the level and so learns where it stands, and what to become (the French-flag model).
$(thing)Set$(): Source, Decay length.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Stirring: the gradient varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too steep: the far end is blank.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A stronger source is faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Signal at the far edge: c(L) = c0.e^(-L/lambda)$(br)Read across the organ: c(L) > threshold
